reden: Yes. The report’s first High finding exactly matches H-04: in AssignmentHook.onBlockProposed the ERC20 fee is taken via safeTransferFrom(_meta.coinbase, …), and _meta.coinbase is proposer-controlled (params.coinbase), defaulting to msg.sender only if zero. This lets a proposer set coinbase to an arbitrary address with an allowance, forcing that party to pay the prover’s fee. The attack path and impact (draining approvals/forcing others to pay) are the same, and binding coinbase to msg.sender would fix both.
